meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation review orchestrator. Launches 5 parallel background sub-agents: Oracle (goal/constraint verification), Oracle (code quality), Oracle (security), unspecified-high (hands-on QA execution), unspecified-high (context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion). All must pass for review to pass. MUST USE before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. Triggers: 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', 'check my work', 'validate changes', 'post-implementation review'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行发起多路审查，把关已完成工作质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在交接已完工作前需要多路审查把关。
copy.tagline_en: Launch parallel review agents to validate completed work before handoff.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need parallel review agents to check your completed work before handoff.

howto.what: 当审查已完成的工作时,Claude 并行启动 5 个后台子代理,分别核对目标与约束、检查代码质量、安全性、实际运行测试、挖掘上下文;全部通过才算通过。
howto.when: 在 PR 交接前,或当你说出“review work”“check my work”等触发词,明确要求审查已完成工作时,此技能会触发。

say.text: 帮我 review 这次的代码改动

say.text: QA 我刚完成的功能,看能不能跑通
say.note: 会实际运行应用做测试

say.text: 检查我的实现有没有遗漏上下文

howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude spawns 5 parallel review sub-agents (goal/constraint check, code quality, security, hands-on QA, context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion). All 5 must pass for the review to pass.
howto.when_en: Triggered before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work, e.g. saying 'review work', 'check my work', etc.

say_en.note: Launches 5 parallel checks: goals, quality, security.

say_en.text: QA the feature I just finished to see if it runs.
say_en.note: Actually runs the application for testing.

say_en.text: Check my implementation for missed context.
say_en.note: Mines background info from git, GitHub, Slack, etc.
